Name: Kish, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:30; 1 Chronicles 9:36: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Kish stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
